prediction_packet_binding.check: Each scoring payload raw answer equals its own method consumer output; one-to-one consumer IDs in all four packets

MDU_BE.loss_caveat: Separate methods own last-step training losses, not a matched cross-model logit comparison

finding: No output misjoin or cross-method prediction-cache copy found in inspected paths. MDU and BE were separately trained with different parameters/targets; their selected source IDs and final short category outputs coincide on every evaluated input.
interpretation: Shared route decisions and saturation on two short edit-source labels provide a concrete explanation of the observed MDU/BE output equality. Other methods differ at raw-output level despite equal coarse aggregate scores. This DEV panel does not isolate the benefit of the MDU training objective.
limits: No claim that the two methods have identical learned parameters or logits.
No claim of exhaustive implementation correctness or equality on other cohorts.
Keep all frozen primary results and negative evidence; no retrospective score/cohort change.
